completed.task: Content-to-Prompt pipeline — generate k AI visibility prompts per content inventory page

details.architecture: Join table content_inventory_prompts (M:N) linking pages to tracked_prompts. ContentToPromptService (LLM generation via OpenRouter) + ContentToPromptOrchestrator (dedup/persist/approve). Follows QueryFanoutService + DailyTrackerOrchestrator patterns.
details.db_schema: content_inventory_prompts: content_inventory_id FK, tracked_prompt_id FK, generation_run_id (nullable), buyer_stage, intent_type, is_branded, approved, is_user_edited. UNIQUE on (inventory_id, prompt_id). 3 indexes.
details.llm: anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6 via OpenRouter. System prompt generates k prompts spanning TOFU/MOFU/BOFU + 4 intent types. JSON structured output. Retry with backoff. Content hash caching.
details.dedup: Tier 1: exact text match via exists_by_text(). Duplicate found = link to existing prompt instead of creating new. Tier 2 (future): semantic embedding similarity.
details.api_endpoints: POST /generate, GET /pages/{id}/prompts, GET /pages/{id}/metrics, GET /pending, POST /approve, POST /regenerate/{id}
details.regeneration: Deletes non-user-edited links, deactivates orphaned prompts (zero remaining links), generates fresh prompts with dedup.
details.content_enrichment: enrich_thin_pages() added to ContentInventoryService — trafilatura fetch for pages with <100 chars content_preview.
details.codex_review: gpt-5.3-codex critical review. Key findings: cascade safety (link CASCADE only), is_user_edited protection, 2-tier dedup, concurrency 8, partial failure model, cost tracking via track_llm_cost().
details.plan_comparison: Evaluated join table (Plan A) vs FK on tracked_prompts (Plan B). Join table won 7/10 dimensions. Critical: tracked_prompts.company_id is String, content_inventory.company_id is UUID — join table sidesteps type mismatch.
details.security_review: Post-implementation critical review found 6 issues. ALL FIXED: (1) CRITICAL: Model not registered in __init__.py — Alembic can't discover. (2) CRITICAL: No tenant isolation in /generate — attacker can generate prompts for other company's pages. (3) CRITICAL: No tenant isolation in /approve — can approve any company's links. (4) CRITICAL: No company validation in orchestrator page loading. (5) HIGH: Dedup TOCTOU race condition (exists_by_text → create). (6) MEDIUM: Prompt injection via page content. Fixes: company_uuid param on orchestrator, _resolve_company_uuid() helper using auth_service, XML tag wrapping for untrusted content, try/except for concurrent dedup.
details.structural_score: compute_structural_score() added to content_performance_service.py. 24 signals across 4 categories (Text Composition 25pts, Structural Elements 21pts, Content Patterns 30pts, Factual Density 15pts). Boolean signals: full weight if True. Numeric: min(1.0, value/benchmark) * weight. Returns 0-100 int. Added to ContentPerformanceRow + ContentDetailResponse schemas. 17 new tests.
details.content_performance_audit: Full audit of Content Performance page readiness. Table: 5/8 columns ready (structural_score now included). KPI: 3/6 ready. Drawer: 3/9 ready. Biggest gap: citation-matching service (~30%) — bridges daily tracker citations → content inventory pages via content_inventory_prompts. Also missing: cluster assignment (TD join), CPS batch scoring, query coverage (GA join), brief compliance.
